anomalies.observed: R13 is a 1k resistor (LCSC C21190, same part family as the 1k PWM series resistor R1), not a 0 Ω jumper. It sits in series between the servo-2 signal pin (Net-(J8-Pin_3)) and the bus-mapped PWM node /NET0027.
anomalies.expected: The spec lists R13 and R14 as 0 Ω jumpers that are shorted for serial-servo mode, and says they are left open in PWM mode. A 1k part in that position cannot be shorted, and it adds a series resistance to the shared serial bus.

evidence.quote: R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus
Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo

anomalies.impact: If R13 is meant to be a jumper, the 1k part adds series resistance to the serial servo bus and can leave bus pin 19/21 driving the servo line through 1k in serial mode, which may weaken or corrupt half-duplex communication. The spec-to-netlist reference numbering is inconsistent, so this finding is uncertain.
